name: Operations & Field Service
short: Field service dispatch, inventory, project management, fleet tracking, procurement, and lifecycle management for teams that keep things running.
intro: Operations run on accurate, real-time information: where crews are, what is in stock, what is due, and what is about to break. These solutions replace whiteboards, phone calls, and spreadsheets with connected systems that schedule, track, and alert automatically.

solutions.name: Field Service Management Platform
solutions.tagline: Dispatch, routing, mobile work orders, and job costing for crews in the field.
solutions.text: A dispatch and work-order management platform for businesses that send technicians, crews, or inspectors into the field: home services, pest control, HVAC, landscaping, or property maintenance. Jobs are created, assigned, and routed automatically based on technician location and availability, field staff get a mobile-friendly view of job details, photos, and digital sign-off, and customers receive automatic on-my-way and completion notifications. The platform tracks parts and labor for accurate job costing, and real-time dashboards give dispatchers full visibility into every crew's status without a single phone call.
for: HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and pest control companies
features: See every tech, job, and status on one live board.
Jobs assigned by location, skill, and availability to cut drive time.
Job details, checklists, photos, and signatures on any phone.
On-my-way texts, arrival windows, and completion summaries.
Parts, labor, and travel tracked against every job.
Invoices sent and paid from the field the moment work is done.
problems: Dispatchers spend the day on the phone
Paper work orders get lost or are unreadable
Customers call asking when the tech will arrive
Nobody knows which jobs actually make money
faq: What is field service management software?
It is software that schedules, dispatches, and tracks work done at customer locations, combining job scheduling, mobile work orders, customer notifications, and invoicing in one system.
Can technicians use it offline?
Yes. Mobile apps cache job details and sync photos, notes, and signatures once a connection returns.
Should we use ServiceTitan or Jobber or a custom system?
Off-the-shelf platforms fit most trades. We implement and automate them, and build custom systems only when your workflow, compliance, or integrations require it.

solutions.name: Inventory & Warehouse Management Platform
solutions.tagline: Real-time stock, barcode scanning, and automatic reordering across every location.
solutions.text: A real-time inventory and warehouse management platform that tracks stock levels, locations, and movement across one or multiple warehouses instead of relying on spreadsheets that are out of date the moment they're saved. Barcode and QR scanning speeds receiving and picking, low-stock and reorder-point alerts trigger purchase orders automatically, and the platform integrates with your e-commerce storefront, POS, or ERP so stock counts stay accurate across every sales channel. Batch and lot tracking is available for businesses with expiration dates or compliance requirements, and reporting dashboards flag slow-moving stock before it ties up working capital.
for: Retailers and e-commerce brands selling across channels
Manufacturers managing raw materials and finished goods
features: Quantities by warehouse, bin, and channel in real time.
Faster, more accurate receiving, picking, and counts.
Reorder points and purchase orders generated from demand.
Traceability for expiration dates and recalls.
Stock shared with your store, POS, marketplaces, and ERP.
Turnover, dead stock, and carrying cost reports.
problems: Stock counts never match the spreadsheet
Stockouts on best sellers and overstock on slow movers
Manual purchase orders based on guesswork
Hours spent on physical counts
faq: When do we need an inventory system instead of spreadsheets?
When you sell across more than one channel, hold stock in more than one location, or regularly oversell or run out. At that point spreadsheets cannot keep up with real-time changes.
Can it handle lot and expiration tracking?
Yes. Lot, batch, and serial tracking with expiration alerts is available for food, health, and regulated products.
Does it integrate with our accounting software?
Yes. Purchases, receipts, and cost of goods sync to QuickBooks, Xero, or your ERP.

solutions.name: Project & Job Management Platform
solutions.tagline: Every project's tasks, budget, schedule, and client updates in one connected system.
solutions.text: A project and job management system configured around how your team delivers work, whether that is construction jobs, client engagements, or production runs. Projects are created from signed quotes with templates for tasks, milestones, and budgets, team members see what is due and blocked, and time and expenses are tracked against the budget in real time. Clients receive automatic progress updates and approvals, change orders are captured and billed, and dashboards show utilization, profitability, and at-risk projects across the portfolio.
for: Contractors and builders running multiple jobs
Agencies, consultancies, and professional services firms
features: Standard tasks, milestones, and budgets created automatically from a signed quote.
Timelines that update when a task slips.
Actuals compared with budget as work happens.
Scope changes approved, tracked, and billed.
Utilization, margin, and at-risk projects in one view.
problems: Project status lives in someone's head or inbox
Budgets overrun before anyone notices
Change orders are done but never billed
Clients ask for updates constantly
faq: Which project management tool should we use?
It depends on the work. Asana, Monday.com, and ClickUp suit services teams, while Procore and Buildertrend fit construction. We configure the right tool and connect it to sales and billing.
Can projects be created automatically from sales?
Yes. When a deal closes or a quote is signed, the project, tasks, budget, and client portal access can be created automatically.
How do we track project profitability?
By logging time, materials, and expenses against each project's budget and comparing them with what was billed, which the system does in real time.

solutions.name: Fleet & Asset Tracking System
solutions.tagline: Know where vehicles and equipment are, how they are used, and when they need service.
solutions.text: A fleet and asset tracking system that combines GPS telematics, equipment tags, and maintenance scheduling in one view. Vehicles and high-value equipment are tracked in real time, preventive maintenance is scheduled automatically by mileage, engine hours, or date, and driver inspections are completed digitally. Alerts flag speeding, idling, after-hours use, and equipment leaving a job site, and reports show utilization so you can right-size the fleet and stop renting equipment you already own.
for: Contractors with vehicles and heavy equipment
features: Vehicle and asset locations on one map.
Service due by mileage, hours, or calendar.
Pre-trip and post-trip checklists with photos.
Notifications for unauthorized use or equipment leaving a site.
Spot waste and coach drivers with data.
Know which assets earn their keep.
problems: Equipment goes missing between job sites
Maintenance is missed until something breaks
Paper inspection forms are incomplete
Paying for vehicles and equipment that sit idle
faq: Can we track equipment that does not have an engine?
Yes. Battery-powered GPS tags and Bluetooth beacons track trailers, tools, and attachments.
Does fleet tracking help with insurance?
Many insurers offer discounts for telematics, and dashcam footage and driving data can help resolve claims.
How does preventive maintenance scheduling work?
Mileage and engine hours come from telematics automatically, and work orders are created when service thresholds are reached.

solutions.name: Procurement & Vendor Management Platform
solutions.tagline: Purchase requests, approvals, vendor records, and three-way matching without paper.
solutions.text: A procurement system that standardizes how your organization requests, approves, orders, and pays for goods and services. Employees submit purchase requests from a catalog or form, approvals route by amount and department, purchase orders go to vendors automatically, and receipts are matched against invoices before payment. Vendor records hold contracts, insurance certificates, W-9s, and performance history with expiration alerts, and spend reporting reveals where to consolidate suppliers and negotiate better terms.
for: Growing companies without a formal purchasing process
Multi-location operators buying from many suppliers
features: Rules by amount, department, and budget.
POs generated and sent to approved vendors.
PO, receipt, and invoice reconciled before payment.
W-9s, insurance, and contracts tracked with renewal alerts.
On-time delivery, quality, and price history.
Spend by category, vendor, and department.
problems: Purchases happen without approval or budget checks
Invoices are paid for goods never received
Vendor insurance certificates expire unnoticed
No visibility into total spend by supplier
faq: What is three-way matching?
It compares the purchase order, the receiving record, and the vendor invoice before payment, so you only pay for what was ordered and delivered at the agreed price.
Is a procurement system only for large companies?
No. Even a 20-person company benefits from simple request and approval rules, especially when several people can spend company money.
Can vendors submit documents themselves?
Yes. A vendor portal lets suppliers upload W-9s, insurance certificates, and invoices directly.

solutions.name: Obsolescence Management Platform
solutions.tagline: Catch end-of-life parts and equipment long before they stop your production line.
solutions.text: A centralized system that tracks the lifecycle status of every component, part, or piece of equipment a business relies on, flagging items approaching end-of-life or end-of-support long before they become a supply chain emergency. The platform continuously cross-references bill-of-materials data against manufacturer lifecycle notices, alerts procurement and engineering teams to at-risk parts, and recommends qualified alternatives, giving manufacturing, defense, aerospace, and industrial clients a proactive way to avoid costly last-time-buy scrambles and unplanned production line stoppages.
for: IT teams managing hardware and software lifecycles
features: Every part checked against manufacturer status data.
Early warning on discontinuation and last-time-buy notices.
Form, fit, and function replacements surfaced for review.
Parts ranked by supply risk and production impact.
Quantities calculated from demand and remaining life.
History of every decision for customers and regulators.
problems: Discontinued parts discovered only when an order fails
Emergency redesigns and broker purchases at premium prices
Lifecycle data tracked by hand in spreadsheets
No early warning for software and hardware end of support
faq: What is obsolescence management?
It is the practice of tracking when components, equipment, and software will be discontinued or lose support, and planning replacements or last-time buys before shortages disrupt operations.
Which industries need obsolescence management?
Any business with long product lifecycles or critical equipment, especially electronics, aerospace, defense, medical devices, industrial automation, and utilities.
Can it monitor software end of support too?
Yes. Operating systems, firmware, and business software can be tracked alongside physical components.
